scenes.setting: Liv's room: the pro-bono pitch breaks through her despair — Daisy vanished from Broken Axe Lane while following Freja home; the tracking token is Daisy's beloved 'vocabulary book', crumpled free-school word lists she hugged in bed and recited at dawn

Outside the apartment: standing orders for Old Kohler — track the laid-off textile women who've 'gone off to unknown places', ask less, listen more — and his quiet confession: 'I've lost my child, so I'm very unwilling to see this sort of thing happen…'
scenes.text_anchor: “I’ve lost my child, so I’m very unwilling to see this sort of thing happen…”

scenes.setting: Dowsing Rod Seeking with the vocabulary book wrapped around the cane head: northwest, half an hour by carriage to Iris Street — a guarded villa with lawns, fountain and ferocious dogs radiating danger. The driver's casual words name it: the home of the rich and powerful Mr. Capim, rumored trafficker of girls
scenes.text_anchor: “Sir, are you not here to visit Mr. Capim?”

scenes.setting: Coffee-shop booth: Fors gives Lawrence Nord the truth-but-not-whole-truth about Aulisa's death and will; alone afterward he despairs — Laubero dead, Richard killed by the Aurora Order, Sam indifferent — 'Will the Abraham family slowly disappear like this?'
scenes.text_anchor: Will the Abraham family slowly disappear like this?
